title: Procedural Dune Sea
concept: Domain-warped wind waves form long dune chains, curved crescent fields or intersecting star dunes, with seeded rocky uplands.
difference_from_base: Builds directional and intersecting wind patterns rather than selecting an existing Skirmish noise style or just a desert biome.
intended_players: 1v1 or two teams, with diagonal, north-south and east-west orientations.
routes: Dune valleys and breaks form organic routes; automatic Skirmish ramp carving ensures tank access to bases and expansion economy.
economy: Core automatic mirrored resources; six protected opening spots. No private metal-count parameter.
known_weaknesses: Extreme advanced dune height and density may require many ramps.
